status: Exploratory reviewer-directed addition after all earlier outcomes and the cohort were inspected; settings recorded before the new filter-only fits and 1-100 Hz outcomes
selection: Fixed final epoch 50, identical training loop and initialization/minibatches to the existing paired fits; validation and ERP outcomes never select checkpoints
affine: Reconstruct all original 20000/4000 rows per task with the original random draws; use original ridge regularization and identical inputs, fit only the added filter-only labels
transfer_fraction: Ratio of paired evaluation-participant mean output shift to mean direct reference shift, not mean of participant ratios; 10000 paired participant bootstrap draws. Report near-zero denominator instability and preserve parent-fit attenuation separately.

passband_sensitivity.people: All 40 participants for both paradigms; unsupervised per-recording recipe, identical notch, ICA seed/budget/decimation, policies, final 30-Hz analysis filter, epochs and endpoint definitions. No retraining on this sensitivity variant.

scope: Effects of supervisory reference choices on digital outputs in an inspected cohort; no attribution of released EEGdenoiseNet label impurity or pure cortical signal loss, no prospective confirmatory claim
